name: GiveHero - The Opening Ask
description: The giving page's first screen, with the real headline rather than a stand-in — its length is what decides whether it breaks over two lines or three against the band's 16ch cap, so a shorter placeholder would review a wrap this band never has. Deliberately quiet for a hero: no photo and no button, because the giving card follows within a screen and a hero that also asked would put two CTAs in front of a reader who has not yet been told what the money does.
